summary: Implemented KAFKA-20444 (KIP-1319): Align TxnOffsetCommit API with OffsetCommit API. Enhanced KafkaProducer.sendOffsetsToTransaction() to ensure metadata for all topics is available before building TxnOffsetCommit requests. This allows the producer to negotiate v6+ of the TxnOffsetCommit API when topic IDs are present in metadata. The implementation extracts unique topic names from the offsets map and calls waitOnMetadata() for each topic to trigger metadata refresh if needed, ensuring topic IDs are populated in the metadata cache. The TransactionManager then uses these topic IDs to build v6+ requests via TxnOffsetCommitRequest.Builder.forTopicIdsOrNames(). Both test cases pass: testSendOffsetsToTransactionNegotiatesV6WhenMetadataKnowsTopicId and testSendOffsetsToTransactionTriggersMetadataRefreshThenNegotiatesV6.
